turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: Morning everyone. Quick one on the Q4 vendor migration. The pilot numbers came back and they look great, so I'm glad we pushed it.

turns.speaker: Priya S.
turns.text: Thanks Marcus. Before we go further, we need to get the vendor quote to Legal this week, because Dana's redline is blocked until it lands and

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: Right, right, let's park that for now. Sam, where are we on the cutover runbook?

turns.speaker: Sam R.
turns.text: Honestly I'm worried. There are still twelve open items on it and the freeze is Friday. I'm not sure we can test the whole cutover in time.

turns.speaker: Jordan M.
turns.text: Wait, sorry, which deadline are we on? I thought the freeze was next Friday. I'm a little lost on the timeline.

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: It's this Friday. That was decided at the Tuesday sync.

turns.speaker: Jordan M.
turns.text: Okay. I don't follow how the security review fits in then. Do I run it before or after the freeze?

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: Let's take that offline. Priya, you had something?

turns.speaker: Priya S.
turns.text: Yes. Like I said earlier, the vendor quote has to reach Legal before Dana can redline the MSA. I've raised this twice now and it keeps getting pushed. It's frustrating.

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: Fair. Okay, I love that, let's do it. Great call, Priya.

turns.speaker: Sam R.
turns.text: I'm nervous about adding more to this week though. If the quote moves up, the sandbox work gets even tighter. What if we miss something on the legacy data export?

turns.speaker: Priya S.
turns.text: I'm confident it's small. I already have the pricing, it's one spreadsheet. I'll send the vendor quote by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: This is unacceptable, by the way, the data processing addendum is still open from last sprint. Who dropped that?

turns.speaker: Jordan M.
turns.text: I think that was mine? I'm not sure what we agreed the scope was, the ticket was unclear.

turns.speaker: Sam R.
turns.text: I'm a bit disappointed we cut the accessibility pass from the cutover. That was the part I was most proud of.

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: We'll come back to accessibility next sprint. Let's keep moving.

turns.speaker: Priya S.
turns.text: Can we get an owner on the addendum before we leave?

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: Moving on. Sam, how is the runbook looking?

turns.speaker: Sam R.
turns.text: I'll have a cutover runbook draft by Friday. The new endpoints are about thirty percent faster, so it's going well.

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: Awesome, that's fantastic.

turns.speaker: Sam R.
turns.text: I'm still anxious about Friday. Could we at least agree a code freeze Thursday at noon?

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: Sure, Thursday noon freeze.

turns.speaker: Lena O.
turns.text: Great. Then I'll have the purchase order ready the moment Legal signs.

turns.speaker: Jordan M.
turns.text: Thank you, that actually helps. I feel better about the security review now.

turns.speaker: Marcus L.
turns.text: Perfect. Good standup, everyone.
